provenance.movement_reasoning: Leena's work items circulate between desk and kitchen table, with deliberate tidy-ups restoring the desk and dishes progressing through sink, rack, and cupboard. Essentials return through the entry after trips; quiet evening items collect around sofa, bed, and nightstand. Cleaning and reset activities reliably return the few temporarily displaced household tools.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A single, home-based ceramic illustrator whose work materials are represented through the allowed object vocabulary. Her home is organized around a compact studio corner and frequent tea breaks, creating a distinct work-from-home pattern without relying on clock-time schedules.
